label: The Quiet Signal
summary: Meridian’s antenna picks up a signal from inside the gas giant. Only you and the station’s oldest engineer believe it is a message.
title: The Quiet Signal
description: For eleven minutes every station night, a pattern rises out of Halcyon’s static. The director calls it weather. The pattern is answering the station’s own test pings.

chapterOutlines.title: Eleven Minutes
chapterOutlines.outline: Catch the signal yourself, and find the one person who has been logging it for years.

chapterOutlines.title: The Director’s Weather
chapterOutlines.outline: Find out why the station’s records of the signal keep disappearing.

chapterOutlines.title: Reply
chapterOutlines.outline: Decide whether to answer, and what to say.

scene.location: The antenna control room on Meridian’s outer ring
scene.summary: Station night. Halcyon fills the window, banded and slow. On the console, the static is starting to repeat.

npcs.name: Kwame Osei
npcs.description: Has been on Meridian longer than anyone and keeps paper notes because paper cannot be wiped.
goals: Prove the signal is real before he retires
abilities: Can fix any system on the station
Remembers every crew member who ever served here

npcs.name: Director Imara Vale
npcs.description: Calm, polished and very sure that there is nothing to see.
abilities: Knows exactly what the supply ship brings, and when
